component.name: Aporia
component.summary: Local-first notebook for structured philosophical arguments

description.p: Aporia is a notebook for reading, writing, and reasoning. Notes are plain Markdown files in a folder you own, so they work with Git and any editor.

Arguments can be written as numbered premises and a conclusion, and a map shows how they fit together. If you install Lean, an argument can be formalized and machine-checked. Lean is optional: every note, argument, search, and paper works without it.
No account, no telemetry, no analytics, and no crash uploads. The app works offline by default.

ul.li: Markdown notes with wiki links, backlinks, and full-text search
Structured argument blocks and a read-only argument map
Optional Lean 4 diagnostics and theorem skeletons
Papers typeset with Typst, exported as PDF, Markdown, or DOCX

description.p: Foundations milestone: no user-facing release yet.
